# PDF fixtures

FileKit generated these original fixtures with [generate.py](generate.py) using pypdf and Pillow. The PDF fixtures are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- `mixed.pdf` has selectable text, mixed dimensions, rotation, external and internal links, and a bookmark.
- `scan.pdf` has a synthetic scanned page.
- `form.pdf` has a text field.
- `encrypted.pdf` uses AES-256 and the test password `filekit-test`.
- `large.pdf` has 321 text pages.
